notes:
- Group screen: Settle, Nudge and Kaun kisko dega in one row. Kaun kisko dega shows who pays whom; the invite link moved into the ⋯ menu.
- Edit a kharcha after saving it, and Undo right after deleting one.
- React and comment buttons now show under every kharcha.
- Capital letters work in names, titles and comments.
- Rename friends added by name, and the group admin can remove someone once their hisaab is zero or make a new invite link.
- One-tap update: the app downloads the new version and opens the installer.
- A short 3-step tour for new users (see it again from Settings > App kaise chalta hai). Invite code box on Home.
- Safer: emails are hidden from group members, nudges are private, unsent kharche survive a busy server, and the app is now signed with a private key.
- Needs Android 9 or newer. Android 8 phones stay on 0.11.0.
- Only the person who added or paid a kharcha, or the group admin, can edit or delete it.
- Server: needs `supabase/migrations/20261011000000_v012_safety_and_editing.sql` and then `supabase/migrations/20261012000000_v012_security_fixes.sql` run once in Supabase before this version is shared.
